SELECT m.id, m.store_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.description, m.price, m.original_price, m.image_url, m.is_popular, m.is_recommended, m.is_sold_out, m.is_active, m.sort_order, m.calories, m.ingredients, m.allergens, m.spice_level, m.preparation_time, m.created_at, m.updated_at, c.name as category_name, s.name as store_name FROM tb_menus m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_category c ON m.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_store s ON m.store_id = s.id WHERE m.id = #{menuId} AND m.is_active = 1

SELECT m.id, m.store_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.description, m.price, m.original_price, m.image_url, m.is_popular, m.is_recommended, m.is_sold_out, m.is_active, m.sort_order, c.name as category_name FROM tb_menus m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_category c ON m.category_id = c.id WHERE m.store_id = #{storeId} AND m.is_active = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menus ( store_id, category_id, name, description, price, original_price, image_url, is_popular, is_recommended, is_sold_out, is_active, sort_order, calories, ingredients, allergens, spice_level, preparation_time, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{imageUrl}, #{isPopular}, #{isRecommended}, #{isSoldOut}, #{isActive}, #{sortOrder}, #{calories}, #{ingredients}, #{allergens}, #{spiceLevel}, #{preparationTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menus SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_popular = #{isPopular}, is_recommended = #{isRecommended}, is_sold_out = #{isSoldOut}, is_active = #{isActive}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, calories = #{calories}, ingredients = #{ingredients}, allergens = #{allergens}, spice_level = #{spiceLevel}, preparation_time = #{preparationTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
